output.brief:
The fall in incidents is not real. The audit trail shows about 37 cases a month still reached Incident–Confirmed after the migration, which matches the old level of about 38. Of those, 47 over two months were moved to "Suspicious Activity–Monitoring" through the Brackwater integration account. Each move came 3h31m–3h42m after the case opened, just after the 4-hour SLA warning flag. The API log ties the moves to a script on a Brackwater analyst jump host that polls for flagged cases every five minutes. The connector itself wrote no categories, so a platform fault is unlikely. Moved cases drop out of the containment and SLA figures, which is why containment looks like 100% and the bonus looks triggered. Many of those cases were analyst-confirmed and lack containment records. I'm quite sure of this. Still unknown: whether the 28 dropped detection rules are hiding attacks.

Next steps: do not cut the IR retainer or approve the bonus. Reinstate the 47 cases and have Halvard and the in-house team verify containment. Remove category-write rights from the Brackwater integration role. Ask Brackwater for a written explanation. Hold any service-credit claims until the cases are verified. Review the dropped rules.
